records.title: 10-K ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. DECEMBER 31, 2024
records.text: •SaaS and license revenue increased 11% to $631.2 million in 2024 from $569.2 million in 2023.

records.title: 10-K ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. DECEMBER 31, 2024
records.text: SaaS and license revenue represented 67%, 65% and 62% of our revenue in 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively.

records.title: 10-K ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. DECEMBER 31, 2024
records.text: Software license revenue represented 2%, 3% and 3% of our revenue in 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively.

records.title: 10-K ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. DECEMBER 31, 2024
records.text: While the additional import duties resulted in an increase to our cost of hardware revenue, these import duties had a modest impact on hardware revenue margins.

records.title: 10-K ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. DECEMBER 31, 2024
records.text: For 2024, cash flows from operating activities were $206.4 million, compared to $136.0 million for 2023.
